key_headlines.title: Real Estate Supply Crisis Deepens Amid Construction Industry Hardships
key_headlines.summary: The construction sector faces a triple crisis from funding shortages, rising construction costs, and regulations, causing project financing balances to drop 19 trillion won over two years. President Lee holds second real estate inspection meeting as government prioritizes housing supply expansion.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Koo Announces Tax Relief for Owner-Occupied Homes Under 3 Billion Won
key_headlines.summary: Homes valued at 3 billion won or less for actual residence will receive comprehensive tax relief on both acquisition and transfer taxes, with 80% deduction on capital gains tax for homes held over 10 years.

key_headlines.title: Government's Redevelopment Housing Supply Falls Far Short of Targets
key_headlines.summary: First-half housing starts from redevelopment of aging public rentals and government buildings reached only 1,370 units, just 28% of the initial 4,893-unit goal for Seoul metropolitan area.

key_headlines.title: Record Heatwave Causes 35,000 Livestock Deaths Daily; Dam Water Levels Plummet
key_headlines.summary: Extreme heat wave results in record livestock deaths with 35,000 animals dying in a single day, while major southern dam water levels drop to half of normal levels amid severe drought conditions.

key_headlines.title: Naver Records All-Time High Quarterly Revenue Through AI Monetization
key_headlines.summary: Naver achieved record 3.39 trillion won in Q2 revenue with 16.2% year-over-year growth driven by AI advertising monetization and strong commerce performance, though operating profit declined 0.2% due to infrastructure investment.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's real estate market faces critical supply challenges as the construction industry struggles with funding shortages, rising construction costs, and regulatory pressures. The government, prioritizing housing supply expansion, held its second real estate inspection meeting this week. Deputy PM Koo announced tax relief measures for owner-occupied homes valued under 3 billion won, reducing both acquisition and transfer taxes. However, the implementation of major housing projects remains sluggish, with first-half completions reaching only 28% of targets. Expert advisors have recommended supporting private rental sectors to stabilize monthly and key money deposits.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's macroeconomic indicators show mixed signals with employment and unemployment deteriorating despite positive trade performance. The Korea Labor Institute projects employment rates to decline to 62.7% this year from 62.9% last year, while unemployment is expected to rise to 2.9%. The record heatwave is creating inflationary pressures in food prices, with the Bank of Korea estimating that a 1-degree temperature increase raises agricultural prices by 0.4-0.5 percentage points. Low-income households face disproportionate burden from rising fruit and vegetable costs, paying 5.8 times more than high-income households. The current account surplus continues to provide economic support amid these domestic challenges.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets opened higher on low-cost buying of semiconductor leaders despite overnight weakness in U.S. exchanges. KOSPI rose 1.09% to 6,365.07 while KOSDAQ climbed 0.74% to 807.62 in early trading. However, markets retreated to mixed territory as uncertainties over the Strait of Hormuz and U.S. employment data weighed on sentiment. U.S. market weakness, driven by rising oil prices and bond yields, spread concerns about continued interest rate increases. Foreign investment banks maintain bullish long-term outlooks, suggesting KOSPI could reach 10,000 points despite recent 39% pullbacks being characterized as temporary adjustments.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's battery industry faces growing Chinese competition with global electric vehicle battery market share dropping below 30% in the first half, excluding China. Chinese robotics firm Unimoon is preparing for IPO at 9 trillion won valuation, reflecting China's dominance with 80% of global humanoid robot market share. Domestically, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and Ministry of Climate and Environment unified battery lifecycle management systems and certification standards to accelerate used battery industry development. This collaboration aims to establish circular economy infrastructure as electric vehicle adoption rapidly expands.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's northern districts experience unprecedented surge in jeonse (deposit lease) prices, with Eunpyeong and Dongdaemun reaching four-year highs due to severe supply shortages. KB Real Estate data shows Seoul apartment jeonse prices rose 0.22% week-over-week, with northern districts significantly outpacing citywide average. Mayor Oh Se-hoon submitted a white paper to the presidential office recommending redevelopment and reconstruction as master keys to housing supply, citing excessive regulations as primary obstacles. Despite government initiatives, redevelopment and reconstruction projects remain sluggish, with housing regulations continuing to constrain supply while demand-supply imbalances intensify regional disparities.
sections.International Economy: U.S. President Trump signed executive orders imposing 15% tariffs on polysilicon derivatives, affecting South Korean imports among others, while establishing minimum import price mechanisms for critical semiconductor materials. Federal Reserve officials debate interest rate policy with some supporting rate increases despite earlier dovish stances, as inflation concerns persist. The U.S. 10-year bond yield continues rising due to oil price increases and inflation expectations, affecting global markets. China's July exports surged 23.9% year-over-year with imports from South Korea jumping 97.8%, while Chinese trade surplus reached $112.5 billion. Russia's economy continues to deteriorate with World Bank projecting growth deceleration to 1% from 4.9% last year.
sections.AI & Economy: Naver achieved record quarterly revenue of 3.39 trillion won in Q2 with successful first-time monetization of AI search and advertising services, though operating profit declined 0.2% due to expanded infrastructure investments. LG's AI solution Exaone outperformed Google and Alibaba on global benchmark tests, demonstrating competitive advantages in manufacturing quality control and healthcare disease prediction applications. South Korea's AI sector shows strong commercial momentum with multiple companies expanding global market presence despite increased investment costs. The AI economy is driving corporate profitability while simultaneously increasing capital expenditure requirements for technological advancement.
sections.Others: Pharmaceutical company Pharmaresearch recorded record first-half sales and operating profits driven by strong demand for Rejuran products domestically and expanded European medical device exports, achieving 47% export growth. The Korea Health Industry Development Institute appointed new director to oversee pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and digital health sectors as government prioritizes biohealthcare industry expansion. Labor unions filed first administrative lawsuit over yellow envelope law while government continues defending interpretation that public sector entities are not original contractors. Anti-corruption authorities reported record 130 billion won in recovered government funds from irregularities last year, with social welfare benefits accounting for largest portion at 29 billion won.
